description: This PHP class extends Symfony's SubmitType to customize the rendering of submit buttons in a form, applying default styles and attributes such as label, icons, CSS classes, and span.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Form\Type\SubmitType
classes.description: A custom form type class that extends Symfony's SubmitType to set default styling options for submit buttons within Goteo's form system.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix used to identify the form type in templates, here overridden to 'submit'.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the submit button, including label, icon class, CSS classes, and row class.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Modifies the form view variables to include icon_class, span, and row_class for rendering.
